_hinweis: Kuratierte Namen fuer Neufunde des Discovery-Scanners. Schluessel = "fg-fn-dp" wie in discovery_found.json. Kopie als discovery_names.json neben discovery_export.py ablegen. Nur Eintraege mit "verified": true werden ohne --all-new exportiert. type/decimal/unit im Stil von hoval_datapoints (U8/S16/U32/STR, decimal = Nachkommastellen, unit z. B. C/%/bar oder leer).
_verifiziert_heisst: Wert per CAN-GET gelesen UND gegen das Bedienteil/einen bekannten Modbus-Wert gegengeprueft (Anzeige stimmt). Reine Vermutungen bleiben verified=false.

1-0-7014.note: Not in Hoval's Modbus datapoint list; on the controller display it is shown as a bare number. Verified on a UltraSource B comfort C17 / TopTronic E: CAN GET returns the same value as the display. Enum meanings not fully known.

1-0-4005.note: ASCII string (up to 13 bytes seen). Returns the circuit name exactly as entered on the TopTronic E display. First text datapoint found on the CAN bus; only answers on fg=1/fn=0 so far.

1-0-505.name_en: Heating circuit 1 operating mode as text (assumption)
1-0-505.note: ASCII string, e.g. 'Konstant' while Modbus 1478 (HC1 operating mode) = 4. Probably the display text of the selected operating mode, not of the status. Not yet confirmed by switching the mode.

1-0-3058.note: Answers to GET with 0. Continues the fg=1 room-setpoint series (3051 normal heating, 3053 setback heating, 3054 normal cooling, 3056 eco cooling). Meaning not confirmed.

1-0-20125.note: Answers with 0 on HC1, HC2 and DHW (fg=2) alike - probably a generic per-circuit status byte.
